_about: Public-domain George F. Pentecost (George Frederick Pentecost, 1842-1920, Baptist and Presbyterian evangelist, Marylebone) for the Word Hoard: 14 books and sermons from Internet Archive scans, 1875-1918, among them The Angel in the Marble (1875), In the Volume of the Book (1885), four years of his Bible Studies on the International Lessons (1888-1893), A South Window (1893) and The Birth and Boyhood of Jesus (1896). Raw OCR. Added 2026-10-17 by lane A, round 22 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
